name: Build
instruction: Outside-in construction. One visual group per write_html call.
sequence: create_artboard (correct width, source font on root)

image_carryover.rule: NEVER replace a source image with a gradient placeholder, colored rectangle, or empty box. Every image in the source must appear in Paper.

methods.when: Image file exists on disk (static asset directory, screenshots)
methods.note: Path must be absolute. Forward slashes. Three slashes after paper-asset:.

methods.when: Interactive component with a running dev server
methods.how: Extract the rendered HTML with inlined computed styles using the dom_extraction method. This is the preferred approach for all interactive components, whatever the framework.

methods.when: Interactive component where DOM extraction failed or dev server is unavailable
methods.how: Screenshot the running component in the browser, save to a temp path, then use paper-asset:// to insert it

methods.when: Image already exists elsewhere in the Paper file

prohibited: Empty boxes with placeholder text like 'Image here'
Screenshots of components when the HTML can be extracted directly
Hand-traced approximations that skip or simplify elements from the source DOM

content_area_patterns.dashboard-grid: flex-wrap: wrap; gap. Card width = (container - (cols-1)*gap) / cols
content_area_patterns.split-pane: Horizontal flex. Sidebar width + flex-shrink: 0. Main flex: 1; min-width: 0
content_area_patterns.css-grid-source: flex-wrap: wrap with computed child widths. Paper has no display: grid

interactive_components.instruction: For interactive components (tabs, carousels, state machines, data grids, component-library widgets), extract the actual rendered HTML from the running page and insert it into Paper. Do NOT screenshot components. Do NOT hand-trace from source code. Use the dom_extraction method below.
interactive_components.exception: Fall back to screenshots ONLY if the page cannot run (see source-audit running_page).

dom_extraction.instruction: Extract the real rendered DOM with computed styles inlined, from the browser. This produces pixel-accurate Paper HTML without manual tracing and works the same for React, Vue and server-rendered pages, because it reads what the browser applied: scoped styles, CSS modules, utility classes and runtime-injected component-library themes included.
method: 1. Open the running page in Playwright (see source-audit running_page) at the artboard width, and wait until data has loaded.
2. Identify the target component by its wrapper class, data attribute or role.

3. browser_evaluate a walker that, for EVERY element under the target: (a) reads window.getComputedStyle and keeps the visually meaningful properties listed in recursive_copy_rules, dropping values equal to the parent's inherited value or the property default; (b) converts display: grid to nested flex (see css_grid_conversion); (c) emits div/span for every tag except svg; (d) keeps svg elements as outerHTML; (e) materializes ::before/::after with non-empty content as absolutely positioned children; (f) sets layer-name from the element's most meaningful class or component name; (g) never emits transition, animation or @keyframes.
4. Map literal values back to tokens with the token-map step (computed styles return resolved values such as rgb() and px, not var()).
5. Insert the output via write_html, one visual group per call.
6. Verify with get_screenshot against the reference screenshot.
recursive_copy_rules: Copy EVERY element, not just the structural containers. Every text node, every icon, every divider, every badge.

For each element, inline ALL visually meaningful CSS properties: display, flex-direction, gap, padding, width, height, background, border, border-radius, color, font-size, font-weight, font-family, letter-spacing, text-transform, line-height, position, top/left/right/bottom, z-index, overflow, opacity, box-shadow, align-items, justify-content.
Do not skip 'small' elements like dots, dividers, or decorative shapes. These define the visual quality.
Preserve the exact nesting structure. Do not flatten or simplify the DOM tree.
For elements with pseudo-elements (::before, ::after), create actual child elements with position: absolute.

css_grid_conversion.instruction: Paper does not support display: grid. Convert to nested flex containers.
method: Read grid-template-columns, grid-template-rows, grid-template-areas from the source CSS.
Calculate column widths from fr units: col_width = (container_width - (cols-1)*gap) * fr_value / total_fr.
Create a vertical flex container (gap matches grid gap).
For each row of grid areas, create a horizontal flex container with children sized to their column widths.
For elements that span multiple rows, nest them in a vertical flex container spanning the appropriate height.

dom_extraction.fallback: If no browser tool is available, inline styles from the project's CSS files with a Node script (class-to-rules map applied to the rendered HTML). This only works for plain global CSS; it misses scoped styles, CSS modules with hashed classes and runtime-injected themes, so flag every component it could not resolve.

css_translation.transition/animation: never write them; Paper drops them. If the motion matters, draw a frame strip next to the component (Start/Mid/End frames captioned with duration, curve and token names), per ../../from-paper/reference/project-conventions.md Paper limits
